rule_title: TTP 1110 - Kerberos Brute Force Against Valid Account (EID 4771 Burst)
description: Detects automated Kerberos password brute forcing against a confirmed-valid domain account. EID 4771 only fires when the account exists — Status 0x18 is wrong password, TargetSid being a real SID (not S-1-0-0) confirms the account is present in the directory. A burst of 10+ failures for the same TargetUserName from the same IP within 30 seconds is the Kerbrute/Rubeus single-account brute force pattern.
